meta.note: All values read verbatim via Figma Plugin API (read-only). alias = Figma alias target; resolved = hex after following the chain. cssName = name in tokens.css.

textStyles.note: 44 text styles = 11 sizes x 4 weights; style name "<Size> / <Weight>". Font family, size, line height and weight are bound to 6. Typography variables.

effectStyles.note: Effect array order as returned by the Plugin API (index 0 first). 22 shadow/focus effect styles + 4 backdrop blurs = 26. colorVariable = bound variable in 1. Color modes (null = literal colour).
